plugins.name: dotbabel
plugins.description: Make an AI coding agent show its work. A verification layer for agentic development: skills that force an agent to ground every claim in real source, reproduce a bug before fixing it, and cite file:line — plus gates that check the result. Includes local CI attestation, spec-governance checks, and one rule floor fanned out to Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and Copilot CLI.
